summary: Seek schedule-started mission runs by their existing ID index

replay.detail: No replay or projection changes. Historical schedule.work-started rows retain their existing matching semantics.

schema.detail: Uses the existing mission_runs primary-key index; no table, index, trigger or schema-version change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Preserves the original exact mission-run reference equality, subject/kind selection and terminal-status exclusions. No phase, origin, scheduling, authority or admission policy changes.

downtime.detail: No additional migration or interruption beyond a normal binary swap.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual migration is required.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores the former read query without durable-state conversion or cache invalidation.
